title: Has anyone here worked on AI training projects as a game developer?
author: Particular_Tour7062
selftext:
Has anyone worked on AI training projects as a game developer?

I came across a remote contractor role looking for Cocos2d-x / 2D game development experience. The work seems to involve building or refining game logic, debugging mechanics, documenting code, and creating real-world examples for AI training.

No AI background was required, just game development experience.

Curious if anyone here has done this type of work before. Is this becoming common for game developers, especially with engines like Cocos2d-x?
